name: dustgate-tools
description: Dev tools for DustGate — mock API server and provisioning utilities

scripts.conformance:ci: node mock-api.js & MOCK_PID=$!; sleep 2; node ../shared/device-model/conformance.js; RC=$?; kill $MOCK_PID; exit $RC
scripts.model:test: node ../shared/device-model/topology.test.js && node ../shared/device-model/shop.test.js && node ../shared/device-model/nodelink.test.js && node ../shared/device-model/plug-claim.test.js && node ../shared/device-model/adopt-outlets.test.js && node ../shared/device-model/manual-blower.test.js
scripts.nodelink:conformance:ci: node mock-node.js & NODE_PID=$!; sleep 1; node ../shared/device-model/nodelink-conformance.js; RC=$?; kill $NODE_PID 2>/dev/null; exit $RC
scripts.topology:conformance:ci: node mock-api.js & MOCK_PID=$!; sleep 2; node ../shared/device-model/topology-conformance.js; RC=$?; kill $MOCK_PID; exit $RC
scripts.firmware:test: npm run firmware:router:test && npm run firmware:controller:test && npm run firmware:nodebus:test && npm run firmware:shop:test && npm run firmware:faults:test && npm run firmware:plugclaim:test && npm run firmware:screen:test && npm run firmware:blower:test
